schema.description:
This schema contains the structure of data for search engine icons which built
from search-config-v2. The associated remote settings collection is
search-config-icons.

engineIdentifiers.description:
An array of search engine identifiers that the attached icon is for. If an
individual entry is suffixed with a star, matching is applied on a "starts with"
basis.
engineIdentifiers.title: Engine Identifiers

filter_expression.description:
A JEXL to filter records. See
https://remote-settings.readthedocs.io/en/latest/target-filters.html#how
filter_expression.title: Filter Expression

imageSize.description:
The image size in pixels. May be used to choose the most appropriate image for
the display.
imageSize.title: Image Size

schema.title: Search Engine Icons Schema
